messages:
Sara (Support): FYI — Acme Solar says they were charged twice on the annual renewal. Two invoices/charges showing up in their portal. Invoice INV-2026-1234 (PO# 98765) and INV-2026-1235 (card). Customer on hold until we confirm refund/cleanup.

Mike (Finance): amount? tax included?

Sara (Support): $12,450.00 each, VAT shown on both. Customer says the PO was submitted right before autopay kicked in. Support ticket #SUP-3321.

Jess (Acct Exec): Customer is upset, says legal will escalate if not reversed by EOD. Can we prioritize? :point_up:

Eli (Payments): I'll pull payment events. Can you DM me the ACME account id?

Sara (Support): Sent. Account: acct_0acme_solar_prod.

OpsBot: payment_event: {"time": "2026-03-05T14:02:11Z", "event": "invoice.created", "invoice_id": "INV-2026-1234", "payment_method": "purchase_order", "status": "posted"}
OpsBot: payment_event: {"time": "2026-03-05T14:02:18Z", "event": "invoice.charge", "invoice_id": "INV-2026-1235", "payment_method": "card_ending_4242", "status": "paid"}

Eli (Payments): Looks like two separate flows: PO invoice issued then ~7s later autopay charged the card. We might have a race where PO fulfillment and autopay were not reconciled.

Mike (Finance): Do we create a credit note or refund the card first? Want clean ledger.

Eli (Payments): Refund card charge immediately (refund id will be created). Then mark the PO invoice as paid using the PO payment, or if the PO was already recorded twice we need to void the duplicate invoice. Proposed steps:
1) Refund charge for INV-2026-1235 -> POST /internal/payments/refunds {charge_id: ch_0abc123} (internal API)
2) Verify refund cleared in 24-48h with acquiring bank
3) Void or credit INV-2026-1235 if it shows as paid in ledger
4) Reconcile PO INV-2026-1234 as the canonical invoice tied to PO# 98765

Sara (Support): Customer asked for immediate reversal from customer-facing portal — they need proof for their AP team. Can we share a receipt/credit note number once refund/void is done?

Eli (Payments): Yes. I'll generate refund id and credit note.

OpsBot: logs snippet: 
```
2026-03-05T14:02:10Z - invoice issued INV-2026-1234 (po:98765)
2026-03-05T14:02:15Z - webhook: account update - payment_terms accepted
2026-03-05T14:02:18Z - autopay trigger: attempt charge account.acct_0acme_solar_prod -> ch_0abc123
2026-03-05T14:02:18Z - charge succeeded ch_0abc123
2026-03-05T14:02:19Z - webhook: payment.succeeded -> creates INV-2026-1235 (duplicate mapping)
```

Eli (Payments): Root cause theory: PO creation and autopay window overlap. System created PO-invoice and also ran autopay which generated a second payable record. Need a guard: when a PO invoice is present and payment_terms indicate PO pending, skip autopay for 30s or until PO is explicitly rejected/expired.

Mike (Finance): Agreed. For now, remediation first. Eli, can you run the refund and drop a credit note here? I'll handle the GL entries after you confirm ids.

Eli (Payments): Initiating refund: internal call returned refund_0r_7789. Refund amount $12,450.00 charged back to card. Creating credit note cnote-ACME-2026-01 for INV-2026-1235 and marking it void in ledger.

Sara (Support): Reply to customer: "We've initiated a card refund and issued a credit note for the duplicate charge. Your PO invoice (INV-2026-1234) remains valid and we will confirm once ledger entries complete. Refund id: refund_0r_7789, credit note: cnote-ACME-2026-01. Apologies for the inconvenience."

Jess (Acct Exec): Customer replied: "Thanks — can you confirm VAT treatment? Our AP needs VAT-only on the PO invoice."

Mike (Finance): VAT should remain on the PO invoice only. Credit note will reverse VAT on the duplicate. I'll check VAT posting and reissue tax report if needed.

Eli (Payments): Follow-up action items:
- Create guard to block autopay if active PO invoice exists (Eli)
- Add metric to track "simultaneous_collection" occurrences (SLO/alerts)
- Postmortem doc (short) and proposed code change to skip autopay when invoice.payment_method == purchase_order and status in [posted, pending] (owner: eng-payments)

Sara (Support): Customer satisfied for now. Jess — please confirm with customer by EOD after VAT note.

Jess (Acct Exec): Will do. Marking as high priority for legal/finance follow-up. :white_check_mark:

Eli (Payments): I'll open a bug and link the repro: reproduce steps: create PO invoice -> submit PO within <10s of invoice creation -> autopay window configured to run every 15s -> observe duplicate charge. Attach logs above.

Mike (Finance): Closing loop: once refund settles and credit note visible to customer, I'll reconcile and close ticket. Keep me posted.

Sara (Support): Closing thread after final confirmation from finance. Thanks team. :pray:
